entry.name: jit.eclipse
entry.description: Divides a matrix sent into the left inlet into a grid with a specified number of rows and columns. Each box in the grid contains a scaled-down representation of the overall matrix. Each box is then tinted so that the overall image resembles a second matrix (sent into the right inlet). If the same image is used in both inputs, the result is a self-similar (or meta-) image.
